name: Andy Beshear

lean.basis: Moderate Democrat elected and re-elected governor of a Republican-leaning state, framing his politics around unity rather than "us versus them".

sources.title: Beshear touts Southern Democratic revival as party searches for 2028 message — Washington Examiner

race_2028.basis: Says he is considering a 2028 run and has not ruled it out; chairs the Democratic Governors Association, a post past presidential hopefuls have used, and polled around 5% in state primary polls.

sources.title: Beshear touts Southern Democratic revival as party searches for 2028 message — Washington Examiner
Beshear says he'd 'consider' 2028 White House run — The Hill via Yahoo

current_role: Governor of Kentucky (since 2019; term ends 2027); chair of the Democratic Governors Association
summary: Andy Beshear (born 1977), son of former governor Steve Beshear, was Kentucky's attorney general and has been governor since 2019, winning re-election in 2023 in a Trump state. He was one of the six finalists Kamala Harris interviewed for running mate in 2024, chairs the Democratic Governors Association, and says he is considering a 2028 presidential run.

sources.title: Beshear touts Southern Democratic revival as party searches for 2028 message — Washington Examiner

connections.name: Kamala Harris
connections.description: One of the six finalists Harris interviewed for her 2024 running mate, seen as a compromise between moderates and progressives; she chose Tim Walz.
